query: Did Tesla beat or miss on EPS last quarter?

guidance.notes: Tesla reaffirmed FY2024 delivery guidance of approximately 1.8 million vehicles, slightly below analyst consensus of 1.82M.

earnings.notes: Revenue slightly missed but EPS significantly beat on cost improvements. Vehicle deliveries of 462,890 beat estimates. Automotive gross margin improved to 17.1%.

answer:
[Source: guidance-tsla-001] TSLA issued Vehicle Deliveries guidance of $1.8M for FY2024 (issued 2024-07-23). Prior analyst estimate was $1.8M.
  Notes: Tesla reaffirmed FY2024 delivery guidance of approximately 1.8 million vehicles, slightly below analyst consensus of 1.82M.

[Source: earnings-tsla-001] TSLA Q3 2024 earnings (reported 2024-10-23): Revenue $25.2B vs. estimate $25.5B — MISS (-1.2%). EPS $0.72 vs. estimate $0.58 — BEAT (+24.1%). Revenue grew 8.2% year-over-year.
  Notes: Revenue slightly missed but EPS significantly beat on cost improvements. Vehicle deliveries of 462,890 beat estimates. Automotive gross margin improved to 17.1%.
